announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.5 — Plugin SketchUp 1.12.1 lebih gampang dipakai: ARA Face (Kisi & Sirip, Ubin & Parket, Perforasi) cukup klik tombol lalu klik dinding/lantai (boleh di dalam group) — hasil langsung jadi dengan jendela pengaturan (ukuran mm, contoh siap pakai seperti granit 60×60 & parket herringbone, gradasi, material ubin & nat), klik hasil lama untuk menyunting. ARA Line & Edit Titik punya jendela panduan langkah demi langkah, Copy Path tidak perlu memilih objek dulu, dan setelan terakhir kini tersimpan. Plugin diperbarui otomatis saat ARA dibuka. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.5 — SketchUp plugin 1.12.1 is easier to use: ARA Face (Slats & Fins, Tiles & Parquet, Perforation) — click the button, then click a wall/floor (inside groups too) — the result appears at once with a settings window (sizes in mm, presets such as granite 60×60 and herringbone parquet, gradients, tile & grout materials); click an existing result to edit. ARA Line & Edit Vertices get a step-by-step guide window, Copy Path no longer needs a selection first, and your last settings are now remembered. The plugin updates automatically when ARA opens. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
